assertions.claim: CPR course at Red Cross or hospital takes half a day to a day, one training lasts years; can be done untrained.
assertions.cn_span: 红十字会或医院的心肺复苏课半天到一天，学一次够用多年

assertions.claim: Of 38,227 cases, 79.2% of cardiac arrests occurred at home — you will most likely press on your own family member.
assertions.cn_span: 38,227 例里 79.2% 的心脏骤停发生在家里

assertions.claim: With bystander CPR, survival-to-discharge rises from 3.9% to 16.1%.
assertions.cn_span: 有人按压，出院时活下来的比例从 3.9% 升到 16.1%

assertions.claim: Send a second person to call 120 and fetch the AED while your hands do not stop.
assertions.cn_span: 让第二个人打 120 和拿 AED，你的手别停

assertions.claim: 53% of arrests were witnessed but only 32% got bystander CPR; overall survival 7.6%.
assertions.cn_span: 53% 的骤停有人目击、只有 32% 得到旁观者按压

assertions.claim: Don't waste time on the renzhong point, finding relatives, filming; don't press weakly for fear of breaking ribs.
assertions.cn_span: 不要先掐人中、先找家属、先拍视频；不要因为怕按断肋骨而不敢用力

assertions.claim: Civil Code art. 184: voluntary emergency rescuer causing harm bears no civil liability.
assertions.cn_span: 自愿实施紧急救助造成受助人损害的，救助人不承担民事责任
